## Change

Describe one feature or fix and its owning module.

## Contract Impact

- [ ] No public contract changed
- [ ] Manifest / CLI / Lua / Box / Interface contract updated and documented

## Verification

- [ ] `mcpp build`
- [ ] `mcpp test --timeout 60 --build-timeout 300`
- [ ] Linked `star` binary smoke tested
- [ ] Fix includes a regression test
- [ ] Release metadata updated when required
